title: AI Engineer
subtitle: Build reliable, measurable, secure products on top of foundation models
summary: Turn foundation models into products: retrieval, agents, evals, security, cost - in production.
expert: Designs AI systems that are measured by rigorous evals, grounded by strong retrieval, safe against injection, fast and cheap to run, and self-hosted or fine-tuned when that is the right call - and can defend every one of those decisions with data.

benchmarks.title: Retrieval
benchmarks.detail: Your hybrid search beats BM25 on NDCG@10 on a public BEIR dataset, with the evaluation code published.

benchmarks.title: Agents
benchmarks.detail: Your agent is evaluated on a public benchmark subset (for example SWE-bench Lite or tau-bench), score and failure analysis published.

benchmarks.title: Evals in CI
benchmarks.detail: Every change to your AI app runs an eval suite that can block a release, with LLM-judge agreement against human labels reported.

benchmarks.title: Open source
benchmarks.detail: At least one merged pull request in a widely used AI library or MCP SDK.

benchmarks.title: Defended out loud
benchmarks.detail: Defend any AI system for 30 minutes: retrieval choices, eval design, cost at 10x users, and how an attacker would break it.
